summary: Greg Brockman states that a tax-prep pilot using OpenAI's Codex processed 7,000 tax returns and cut preparation time by about a third, and notes that developers can build their own products on Codex's open-source harness.

practices.reason: An open-source harness for Codex is offered as a base for building new products, which is an integration surface engineering teams could adopt but the post gives no implementation detail.
practices.quote: you can build your own products on our codex open-source harness: https://t.co/49dqhEktSC
